capabilities.body: OpenAmer e rera mosebetsi, e o etsa ka dithulusi tsa sebele — theminale, sebatli, difaele, khoutu — mme e boloka se sebeditse.
capabilities.title: Moemedi ya nahanang le wena

capabilities.body: Dipuisano, mohopolo le dimotlele di dula khomphutheng ena. Ha ho letho le kenngwang inthaneteng ntle le ha o kopa.
capabilities.title: Disebediswa tsa hao, data ya hao

capabilities.body: Dipuo tse 186, e nngwe le e nngwe ka mongolo oo o o balang. Skrine sa pele sa app se o botsa hore na o kgetha efe.
capabilities.title: Puo ya hao, ka nepo

capabilities.body: Bokgoni bo bolokwa ho tswa mosebetsing ka boona, kahoo mesebetsi ya letsatsi le letsatsi e potlaka ha o ntse o e sebedisa.
capabilities.title: Bokgoni bo holang

help: Hlahloba hore khomphutha ena e kgona ho kena inthaneteng.
Qala tlhophiso hape — mehato e qetilweng ha e phetwe.
Ha e hloleha habedi, bula direkoto; mela ya ho qetela e bolela mohato.
failure.lead: Ha ho diphetoho tse kgutlisitsweng morao ka lekunutu — OpenAmer e ema moo e emisitseng teng, kahoo ha e qalwa hape e tswela pele ho tloha moo.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer e ntse e le mofuteng o fetileng mme e ntse e sebetsa. Ha ho letho le nkettsweng sebaka ka halofo.
failure.title: Tlhophiso ha ya phetheha

language.lead: Tlhophiso e tswela pele ka puo eo o e kgethang mona. O ka e fetola hamorao ka hara app.
language.title: Kgetha puo ya hao

progress.lead: Tlhophiso ya hang feela: OpenAmer e jarolla seo e se hlokang mme e hlophisa khomphutha ena. Ha e qalwa hamorao e tlola tsena tsohle.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer e nkela mofuta o fetileng sebaka. Dinako tsa hao tsa tshebetso, mohopolo le ditlhophiso ha di fetolwe.
progress.stepsComplete: Mehato e {done} ho e {total} e phethilwe
progress.title: Ho hlophisa OpenAmer

stages.node-deps: Ho kenya diphuthelwana tse hlokehang tsa Node.js

stages.venv: Ho etsa tikoloho ya sebele ya Python

cards.body: Bula app mme o hlalose seo o batlang hore se etswe. OpenAmer e sebetsa ka morao mme e o tlalehela.
cards.title: Qala ka polelo

cards.body: Ditlhophiso → Pontsho → Puo. Dikgetho tsa puo le sebaka tse 186, di ka fetolwa neng kapa neng.
cards.title: Kgetha puo ya hao

cards.body: Mosebetsi o iphetang o fetoha bokgoni — nakong e tlang o hloka taelo e le nngwe feela.
cards.title: E dumelle ho hopola

success.errorTitle: Ha ho a kgoneha ho qala app ya komporong
success.lead: Tsohle di lokile. OpenAmer jwale ke ya hao — khomphutheng ena, ka puo ya hao.
success.title: OpenAmer e lokile

bullets: E sebetsa khomphutheng ya hao — dipuisano tsa hao di dula mona

welcome.lead: Moemedi wa hao. Disebedisweng tsa hao. Ka puo ya hao.
welcome.leadUpdate: Mofuta o motjha wa OpenAmer o lokile. O nkela mofuta o fetileng sebaka mme o boloka dinako tsohle tsa tshebetso le ditlhophiso tsohle.
welcome.note: Ho nka metsotso e seng mekae ka kgokelo e tlwaelehileng.
welcome.title: Rea o amohela ho OpenAmer
